entities.summary:
Marina Makropoulou is a Romanian and Greek chess player who holds the title of Woman Grandmaster. Her peak Elo rating is at 2330 in 1994. She is a Romanian Women's Chess Champion (1984) and nine time Greek Women's Chess Champion - which is the record for most Greek Women's Chess Championships. With her 2022 win, she tied 
Viktor Korchnoi's record for winning an Individual National Championship in 5 different decades.
